notes:
Opened talk2me straight from Downloads? Home offers to move it to Applications, so updates can install. The copy in Downloads stays until you delete it. Update now also works from a copy that macOS runs from a locked place, or says plainly what to do.
Home and the tour name the same voice model from the first second: the one being downloaded for your Mac. Until it lands, Home says the starter voice is standing in.
The day your full voice model lands, Home says so once: "Your full voice model is here."
